name: PiGallery 2
short_desc: Fast directory-first photo gallery, optimized for low-resource servers. Reads your existing folder structure as-is.
description: A fast directory-first photo gallery website, optimized for running on low-resource servers (especially Raspberry Pi). Point it at your photo folder and it shows your directory structure as-is — no database uploads, no ML, no duplication. Generates thumbnails on-the-fly and caches them for instant repeat views. Supports EXIF metadata, timeline view, map with GPX tracks, video playback, and multi-user access control.
author: bpatrik
